title: Routed experts on the CPU tier in the device's declared order
description: host-expert-tier's contract. Host form: routes grouped by expert in route order, at most max_tokens a chunk, each route's unweighted output row in FP32, then device_sum multiplies by the routing weight and sums a token's routes in plan order with one FP32 rounding per operation (within FP32 rounding of the reference). Device form on the CPU: nvfp4 (W4A4) and int4 (W4A8) experts as bundles read in place, each route's row in host-expert-arithmetic's declared integer block order (the bits of a device kernel that declares it), summed in route order by FMAs; the native tier (C++ over the host's pinned worker pool, built at load) or the same order in torch where it does not build.

max_tokens.description: host form: routes of one expert in a chunk

native.description: the device form's rows: the native tier built at load (on: refuse to load without it), or the declared order in torch (off), the same bits; auto takes the native tier where it builds

workers.description: the workers of the host's pool (Core's, crit_plugins.host: one a process) when this plugin is the first to ask for it (-1: Core's plan, one per physical core but the caller's)

pin.description: with workers: pin each worker of the host's pool to a physical core of its own (Linux)

rows_per_task.description: rows of one expert in a pool task
